instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for BeamEcho Field Query Log: The project controls the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details. Trade Supervisors submit questions with the affected work area and a description, Site Engineers review them, add observations, and route them to Design Coordinators, Design Coordinators record responses and indicate whether work may proceed or remain paused, and Document Controllers link final responses to drawing records before closure. The method for selecting the relevant Design Coordinator is unresolved, and the tool does not replace drawing revision control.

output.summary: BeamEcho Field Query Log controls the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details. Trade Supervisors, Site Engineers, Design Coordinators, and Document Controllers manage question details, review, routing, responses, work status, and closure links. The Design Coordinator selection method remains unresolved, and drawing revision control is outside the project.
output.primary_goal: Control the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details.
key_capabilities: Submit field questions with the affected work area and a description.
Review field questions and add site observations.
Route field questions to Design Coordinators.
Record responses and indicate whether affected work may proceed or remain paused.
Link final responses to drawing records before field-question closure.
unresolved_points: The method for selecting the relevant Design Coordinator is unresolved.
